create_model_VGG_Cplus: create a VGG-style sparse convolutional neural network model for Chinese handwriting classification
build_sparsevggnet_layers: build a 2D SparseVggNet with convolutional blocks, max pooling, batch normalization, and ReLU activations
run_classification_training: run sparseconvnet classification training with configurable epochs, learning rate, and weight decay
get_dataset_iterators: get dataset iterators for sparse convolutional network training using spatial size and data scale parameters
apply_sparse_to_dense_conversion: apply SparseToDense layer to convert sparse tensor representation to dense feature maps
